message.content: {"caption":"A process diagram showing how an agent retrieves, extracts, and consolidates memories while handling a sequence of tasks.","description":"A left-to-right timeline ends in an arrow labelled “Time” and marks “Task q₁,” “Task q₂,” an ellipsis, “Task qᵢ,” another ellipsis, and “Task qₙ.” Above it, the process begins with a rounded box labelled “ReasoningBank: a collection of memory items,” accompanied by a puzzle-piece icon. A downward arrow labelled “(i) Memory Retrieval” leads from the bank to a rounded “ℋ: experience/trajectory” panel. Inside that panel, a person representing qᵢ points right to a robot labelled “Agent”; the Agent and a laptop labelled “Env” are connected by a two-headed arrow. A right-pointing arrow carries the trajectory to “LLM-as-a-Judge.” Under “(ii) Memory Extraction,” the judge branches to “Success Insights,” marked with a green check, and “Failure Reflection,” marked with a red X. These outputs lead toward a clipboard-and-pencil icon labelled “Memory Items.” A left-pointing arrow connects the illustrated memory-item example on the right back toward Memory Items. An upward arrow labelled “(iii) Memory Consolidation” leads from the memory-item area back to ReasoningBank. The large rounded example panel on the right shows a clipboard icon beside “Memory Item j.” Its card lists the title “Prioritize user account sections for personal data,” a description beginning “When a query requests user-specific …,” and content beginning “Systematically look for and click on links …”; the latter two are visibly truncated with ellipses. Below it, an upward arrow points from a “Memory Extractor” box to the card. Beneath the extractor are “Experience/Trajectory ℋ,” with a thought snippet “… I need to navigate to …” and an action `click('188')`, and “Task qᵢ: Tell me the status of my latest order and when it will arrive,” each accompanied by a small person-related icon.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
